SPY.title: US Stocks Set For Steep Fall Amid Heightened Anxiety Ahead Jobs Data, VIX Surges: Strategist Flags 2 Reasons Why He Expects More Volatility Ahead
SPY.description: US stock futures are down ahead of the upcoming jobs report, with the Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures declining. Traders are cautious due to concerns about the economic outlook and the Federal Reserve's policy trajectory.
SPY.author: Shanthi Rexaline
